{{Quote|Ardana is currently dominating the simulator charts."<br />"The operative word being 'currently'".<br />"Is that a challenge Antilles?|[[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] introduces Cinn, who is teased by [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] before retorting|<ref name="Star Wars (2013) 2">[[Star Wars (2013) 2|''Star Wars'' (2013) 2]]</ref>}}
'''Ardana Cinn''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] she became a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], where she scored the highest amongst her fellow pilots in flight simulations. She performed with enough skill and was deemed trustworthy enough to be selected by [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] to be part of a [[Stealth Squadron|team]] to uncover a mole within the Alliance. The team worked entirely off the books, with only [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] knowing of their existence outside of the team's members. As well as discovering the mole they were also tasked with finding a suitable planet on which the Alliance could set up a new base.

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Ardanna Cinn first appeared in the [[Star Wars (2013) 2|second issue]] of the comic book series titled simply [[Star Wars (2013)|Star Wars]] published by [[Dark Horse Comics]]. The issue was written by [[Brian Wood]], illustrated by [[Carlos D'Anda]] and colored by [[Gabe Eltaeb]]. It was released on [[February]] [[February 13|13]] [[2013]].
